consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9006 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 9 July 2015 a hazard report was recorded on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
